EraseSequences

Clear runs of blank cells with erase sequences (EL to the end of a row, ECH inside it) instead of writing spaces, when that is fewer bytes. Erased cells take the current background color (BCE), which modern terminals support; turn off for one that doesn't.

public bool EraseSequences { get; init; }

bool

KeyReleaseEvents

With Tuinet.TerminalOptions.KittyKeyboard: also report key repeats and releases (Tuinet.KeyEvent.Kind), e.g. for hold-to-move. Releases never match Tuinet.KeyEvent.Is(Tuinet.KeyCode,Tuinet.Modifiers), Tuinet.KeyEvent.IsChar(System.Char) or Tuinet.KeyEvent.IsCtrl(System.Char), but code reading Tuinet.KeyEvent.Code directly must check the kind.

public bool KeyReleaseEvents { get; init; }

Property Value

bool

KittyKeyboard

Ask the terminal for the kitty keyboard protocol (kitty, Ghostty, foot, WezTerm, recent Alacritty and iTerm2): keys that legacy encoding can't tell apart arrive distinct (Ctrl+I vs Tab, Ctrl+M vs Enter, Ctrl+[ vs Esc, Ctrl+Shift+letter), and Esc arrives at once instead of after Tuinet.TerminalOptions.EscapeTimeoutMs. Terminals without it ignore the request; Tuinet.Terminal.KittyKeyboardActive says whether it took effect.

public bool KittyKeyboard { get; init; }

Property Value

bool

ScrollRegions

When a band of full-width rows scrolls, let the terminal move them (scroll margins plus insert/delete line) instead of repainting every row. On terminals that report left/right margins (DECLRMM, asked at startup; see Tuinet.Terminal.LeftRightMarginsActive) bands narrower than the screen move too, such as a list beside a panel. Turn off for a terminal that mishandles them.

public bool ScrollRegions { get; init; }

Property Value

bool

SuspendOnCtrlZ

Handle Ctrl+Z inside Tuinet.Terminal.Poll(Tuinet.Event@,System.Int32) by calling Tuinet.Terminal.Suspend, so the app can be backgrounded like a shell command. Off by default: Ctrl+Z is a normal key. Where suspending isn't supported (Windows) the key is delivered as usual.

public bool SuspendOnCtrlZ { get; init; }

Property Value

bool
